TFs data

tfs.tuto.Rd

Data frame with the inferred TFs activity across samples: compute.TFs.activity() on counts.norm.tuto with its defaults (CollecTRI regulons, "ulm", scaled). Built with data-raw/tutorial_data.R.

Usage

tfs.tuto

Format

A data frame with 192 samples as rows and 770 TFs as columns

Examples

data(tfs.tuto)
head(tfs.tuto)
